verses.text: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
lines: Yahweh, I have called on you.
Come to me quickly!
Listen to my voice when I call to you.

verses.text: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
lines: Let my prayer be set before you like incense;
the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

verses.text: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
lines: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth.
Keep the door of my lips.

verses.text: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
lines: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing,
to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity.
Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

verses.text: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
lines: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness;
let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head;
don’t let my head refuse it;
Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

verses.text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
lines: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock.
They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

verses.text: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
lines: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth,
our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

verses.text: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
lines: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord.
In you, I take refuge.
Don’t leave my soul destitute.

verses.text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
lines: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

verses.text: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
lines: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets
while I pass by.
